metadata.description: Price per square meter data update for Israeli cities - compiled from official sources and market data
notes: price_per_sqm values are in ILS per square meter
Data is compiled from multiple sources: CBS, nadlan.gov.il transaction data, and market reports
2025 data is based on Q3-Q4 2025 reports; 2023 data is based on full year 2023 averages
For cities where direct price-per-sqm data was unavailable, estimates were derived from average apartment prices divided by typical apartment sizes for that city/region

verification_5_major_cities.description: Verification of nadlan_price_trends data for 5 major cities against publicly available data

ירושלים.assessment: DISCREPANCY - Our nadlan_trends show median ~2.59M for Q1 2025, but CBS/ynet reports average ~3.16M for Q1 2025 and ~3.33M for Q4 2025. Likely difference between median (our data) vs mean (CBS reports). Also, our data appears to be for ALL apartment types weighted differently. The trend direction (upward) is consistent.
ירושלים.price_per_sqm_source: SandsOfWealth reports 45,785 ILS/sqm; GlobalPropertyGuide reports 32,200 ILS/sqm. Our all_cities_combined has 36,500 for 2026 - this is reasonable as a median figure.

תל אביב-יפו.assessment: CONSISTENT - Our nadlan_trends show ~3.5-3.7M range for recent quarters. CBS reports Q4 2025 average at 4.16M (boosted by luxury segment). Q3 2025 average was 3.68M which aligns well. Trend: slight decline mid-2025 then recovery Q4.
תל אביב-יפו.price_per_sqm_source: SandsOfWealth: 70,341 ILS/sqm; GlobalPropertyGuide: 59,200 ILS/sqm. Our all_cities_combined has 57,000 for 2026 - slightly conservative but reasonable for median transactions.

חיפה.assessment: CONSISTENT - CBS reports average ~1.83M for Q4 2025 for Haifa. Our price trends likely show similar trajectory. Haifa showed 11.7% YoY growth.
חיפה.price_per_sqm_source: SandsOfWealth: 24,110 ILS/sqm; GlobalPropertyGuide: 21,690 ILS/sqm. Our all_cities_combined has 16,500 for 2026 - this seems LOW compared to these sources. Recommend updating to ~21,000-22,000.

באר שבע.assessment: CONSISTENT - CBS reports average ~1.28M for Q4 2025. Our trends are aligned.
באר שבע.price_per_sqm_source: SandsOfWealth: 16,000-18,500 ILS/sqm; GlobalPropertyGuide: 12,340 ILS/sqm. Our all_cities_combined has 14,500 for 2026 - within range, slightly conservative.

ראשון לציון.assessment: CONSISTENT - Reports show ~2.31-2.57M range. YoY decline of ~7.3% noted. Our trends capture this downward movement.
ראשון לציון.price_per_sqm_source: Our all_cities_combined has 30,500 for 2026. Given avg price ~2.4M and typical 80sqm apartment, implied price/sqm is ~30,000. Reasonable.

price_per_sqm_updates.description: Updated price_per_sqm values for cities currently with NULL values in the database. Values for 2023 are estimated based on 2025 data minus estimated growth. Values for 2026 are based on latest available data and trend projections.
price_per_sqm_updates.methodology: For cities with Q4 2025 average apartment prices from CBS/ynet: price_per_sqm = avg_price / estimated_avg_apartment_size. Average apartment sizes vary by city (60-100 sqm typically). For peripheral cities, average sizes tend to be larger (85-100 sqm); for central cities, smaller (65-85 sqm).

existing_data_corrections.description: Suggested corrections for existing price_per_sqm values that seem off based on 2025 market data

חיפה.reason: Multiple sources (SandsOfWealth: 24,110; GlobalPropertyGuide: 21,690) indicate Haifa is above 20K/sqm in 2025. Our current values seem to reflect only lower-end neighborhoods. Suggest updating to reflect city-wide average.

הרצליה.reason: The 55% jump from 2023 to 2026 seems too steep. Market data shows Herzliya actually declined ~8.3% YoY in 2025. The 2023 value may be too low or the 2026 too high. Avg apartment ~3.97M / ~105sqm = ~37,800/sqm. Suggest moderating both values.

רמת השרון.reason: 25% jump seems too steep for this period. Ramat HaSharon is premium but price growth has been moderate.

עפולה.reason: 39% jump seems high but Afula has been among fastest-growing cities. Sources confirm 16K-25K range for budget cities. Moderate adjustment suggested.

database_notes.nadlan_deals_summary_table: The prisma schema shows a nadlan_deals_summary table with avg_price_per_sqm column - this likely contains per-quarter price/sqm data from nadlan.gov.il transactions. This data should be queried to derive city-level price_per_sqm values for cities currently missing data.
database_notes.recommended_query: SELECT city_name, AVG(avg_price_per_sqm) as avg_psm FROM nadlan_deals_summary WHERE year >= 2024 AND avg_price_per_sqm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city_name ORDER BY avg_psm DESC
database_notes.action_needed: Run the above query to extract price_per_sqm from existing nadlan_deals_summary data and use it to fill NULL values in the cities table. This is the BEST source since it's actual transaction data.

nadlan_gov_api_notes.note: The nadlan.gov.il API can be used to fetch per-deal data including price per sqm. Settlement IDs needed. Recommend using these GitHub tools to bulk-fetch updated data.
